create.name: Fay Johnstone
create.bio:
Fay Johnstone is a Scottish teacher of earth-based spirituality who works with plants as spiritual allies. She began practising Reiki in 2000, which led her into gardening, foraging and the study of herbal medicine, and during years spent growing organic flowers on a farm in Nova Scotia her practice settled into a close relationship with the land and its plants. She now teaches what she calls creative shamanism, alongside Plant Spirit Reiki, the approach she developed, and a gentle form of Elemental Qigong.

From her home garden and yurt on the Firth of Forth in Fife she hosts small bespoke retreats and a five-day Plant Spirit Summer School, and she leads weekly qigong classes in Culross and Burntisland. Online, she runs a six-week Plant Spirit Reiki foundation course, offers recorded intuitive readings, and keeps a monthly community circle and podcast called Shaman in the Garden. Her three books are Plant Spirit Reiki, Shamanic Reiki Drumming and, the first, Plants That Speak, Souls That Sing. Her YouTube channel carries seasonal garden practices, guided meditations and conversations with other plant and land teachers.

books.title: Plant Spirit Reiki: Energy Healing with the Elements of Nature
books.author: Fay Johnstone
books.description: Fay Johnstone's guide to combining Reiki with conscious connection to plants, treating them as living teachers and partners. It sets out the approach she teaches on her courses, with practices for working with plant energies.

books.title: Plants That Speak, Souls That Sing: Transform Your Life with the Spirit of Plants
books.author: Fay Johnstone
books.description: A practical introduction to meeting plants, seasons and natural cycles in a more attentive and ceremonial way. Her first book, it draws on shamanic practice that starts with local plants at home.

books.title: Shamanic Reiki Drumming: Intuitive Healing with Sound and Vibration
books.author: Fay Johnstone
books.description: A guide to bringing the shamanic drum into Reiki practice. It covers journeying with a drum, the three shamanic worlds and meeting spirit guides, and protocols for drumming for oneself, for others and in groups.

courses.title: Plant Spirit Reiki Online Foundation
courses.description: A six-week online training with live classes and replays in six core modules. Students learn to sense plant energies, trust their intuition and work with plants as partners, and receive a Plant Spirit Reiki activation.

courses.title: Bespoke Garden Retreats in Fife
courses.description: Three-day all-inclusive individual retreats in her coastal walled garden and yurt in Fife, about half an hour from Edinburgh. They draw on shamanic practice, ceremony and time with plant allies, shaped around what each guest is seeking.

courses.title: Plant Spirit Summer School
courses.description: A five-day immersion for up to eight people in her garden in Fife, spent listening to and working with plants through breath, energy practice and ceremony. The 2027 dates are still to be confirmed; a deposit secures a place.

courses.title: Elemental Qigong Classes
courses.description: Weekly in-person classes in Fife combining slow movement, breathing and meditation based on the natural elements. Beginners are welcome and no equipment is needed.
courses.price: £10 GBP drop in / £50 GBP for a 6-week block

courses.title: Intuitive Readings
courses.description: A recorded reading delivered as an mp3, in which she brings through guidance on the client's path and situation from her helping spirits. Booking is via an intake form, with the recording sent within a few working days.
